authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full cāmala/cāvala explicitly gives Bihari/Maithili/Bhojpuri cāur, Bengali cāul/cāl, Oriya cāura/cāuḷa, Punjabi caul and Jaunsari cau husked rice. These support the selected affricate, rhotic/lateral and reduced rice responses. Source spacing, aspiration, vowels, nasalization and the exact rice/uncooked-rice gloss remain unchanged; local reductions and cross-IA transmission are qualified. Turner’s uncertain ultimate origin is not replaced with a new donor claim. Exact response: caoḍ.
